sources.title: In 2026, less than one third of Google searches still send a click
claims: US Google zero-click rate measured at 68.01% for January through April 2026, with about 276 clicks to the open web per 1,000 searches. SparkToro also reports AI Mode at 0.34% of searches in that same US January through April 2026 panel.
supports_claims: US Google zero-click rate measured at 68.01% for January through April 2026, with about 276 clicks to the open web per 1,000 searches. SparkToro also reports AI Mode at 0.34% of searches in that same US January through April 2026 panel.
sources.methodology: Similarweb desktop and mobile web panel for United States Google searches from January through April 2026; mobile and desktop weighting described by SparkToro.
sources.limitations: Directional third-party clickstream analysis. It excludes the Google mobile search app and combines panel sources that are not directly comparable to older studies.

sources.title: AIO impact on Google CTR 2026 update
claims: AI Overview present organic CTR rebounded from about 1.3% in December 2025 to about 2.4% in February 2026 in the cited Seer analysis.
Being cited in an AI Overview is associated with about 120% more clicks per impression than not being cited.
supports_claims: AI Overview present organic CTR rebounded from about 1.3% in December 2025 to about 2.4% in February 2026 in the cited Seer analysis.
Being cited in an AI Overview is associated with about 120% more clicks per impression than not being cited.
sources.methodology: Seer analysis across 53 brands, 5.47M tracked queries, and 2.43B organic impressions from January 2025 through February 2026, with March 2026 projections.
sources.limitations: Directional practitioner analysis. Do not present AIO citation association as causal or guaranteed for a client site.

sources.title: AI Mode research: Volatility, source patterns, and differences from AIO and organic results
claims: SE Ranking reported an average of 12.6 links per AI Mode answer across 9,734 triggered responses from a 10,000-keyword US sample collected on 2025-06-20.
SE Ranking reported high AI Mode source volatility and limited overlap with AI Overviews and organic search results.
supports_claims: SE Ranking reported an average of 12.6 links per AI Mode answer across 9,734 triggered responses from a 10,000-keyword US sample collected on 2025-06-20.
SE Ranking reported high AI Mode source volatility and limited overlap with AI Overviews and organic search results.
sources.source_pool: SE Ranking AI Mode study and claim-ledger remediation
sources.limitations: Vendor study using a 10,000-keyword US sample and 9,734 triggered AI Mode responses. Treat as a practitioner benchmark, not Google first-party truth.

sources.title: AI Mode comparison study
claims: Semrush reported that 92% of AI Mode responses in its 5,000-keyword desktop study used a sidebar with links averaging about seven unique domains.
AI Mode behavior should be handled as a distinct optimization surface from classic organic results and AI Overviews.
supports_claims: Semrush reported that 92% of AI Mode responses in its 5,000-keyword desktop study used a sidebar with links averaging about seven unique domains.
AI Mode behavior should be handled as a distinct optimization surface from classic organic results and AI Overviews.
sources.limitations: Vendor study of 5,000 desktop queries across four platforms. Does not support the 12.6 links-per-answer statistic, which belongs to se-ranking-ai-mode-research.
